title: 第11章 被下了咒第12章 调查到了
slug: 算命太准外国客户都哭着喊大佬
content_zh:
第11章被下了咒
可是昨晚上他们把家里所有视频，不仅仅是昨天，连带着前面好几天的视频都翻来覆去的看了一遍，甚至还请了这方面的专家一块探查，也都没有发现任何异样。
这段时间保姆和育儿师如同往常任何一天一样，一个负责照顾孩子的饮食起居，一个负责陪孩子玩耍和启蒙教育。
童童丢失的时候是上午十点左右，保姆在做上午茶，而育儿师虽然略有失职去上厕所了，但是人有三急，他们也不能让人家憋着吧。
而且孩子平时很乖，从来没有出现过自己打开门偷跑出去的情况，再加上客厅里还有他最爱的玩具，谁也不会想到他玩着玩着会起身离开。
没有人叫他出去，反倒像是他自己被什么吸引，或者说指引着跑了出去似的。
至于外面等着的面包车，也可以解释为他们早就做好了踩点工作，一直蹲守在附近，只等到童童出来就迅速行动。
可不知为什么，钱康还是觉得这件事情绝对有家里人的参与！
只可惜没有证据，光凭他的直觉什么也证明不了。
钱康苦笑一声，对着林熙沉静的眼眸，不自觉吐出自己心中的烦恼。
“暂时还没什么发现，所有证据都表明是孩子自己跑出去的，可是……”
可是什么，钱康没再继续说了，毕竟这件事情连他们钱家都找不到证据，眼前这个小姑娘又怎么可能知道呢。
林熙看着他，淡声道：“你儿子被人施了傀儡咒。”
傀儡咒？！
钱康夫妻俩猛的愣住。
两人祖上一直都是做生意的，生意人难免信鬼神之说，他们家和公司都是花大价钱找人特意看过风水的，所以对于林熙说的傀儡术，两人起初只是觉得陌生，但理解了这词的意思后，瞬间严肃几分。
“林小姐，可否借一步说话。”
托钱家老祖宗们的福，钱康自小便属于站在同龄人顶端的那群人。
站得高看得远，见过的世面自然也就多了，他也更坚信一句话，那就是人外有人，天外有天，有的天才从来不会受年龄和性别的限制。
虽然眼前的林熙看上去一点不像懂玄学之术的天师，但仅从她能在火车上辨认出人贩子这一点，钱康就觉得这姑娘将来必定不凡。

如果她说的是真的话，或许儿子莫名出走的疑团也能水落石！
林熙不方便带他们去风水铺，便干脆和钱康三人上了车，在车里聊了一下。
她将傀儡咒的作用简单跟钱康他们说了一下，接着道：“要想找出施咒的人很简单，咒法被破，施咒之人必会遭到反噬，你们可以找人调查一下家里谁情况不对。”
而她刚刚给童童拂去阴气的瞬间，也顺势将这小小的傀儡咒给破了。
钱康一听，立刻掏出手机给在临水的父亲打了电话，让他派信得过的人去钱康家里查看情况。
钱康和父母住在同一个别墅区，两家就在隔壁栋，接到儿子的电话，钱老爷子当即带着跟随他多年的亲信去隔壁钱康家查看情况。
结果刚刚走到钱康家门口，就看到保姆一脸惊慌的打开屋门往外冲。
看到钱老爷子，保姆当下哭着喊救命：“钱老先生，周老师刚刚还好好的，结果忽然吐血了！”
钱老先生一听，眼神一凛，快步走进去查看，果然看到孙子童童的育儿老师周老师坐在凳子上，口吐鲜血，胸前衣服都被鲜血打湿。
想到刚刚儿子电话里跟他说的，钱老先生面沉如水，看着表情痛苦的周老师，冷笑一声。
“周老师，是你吧。”
周老师身子一僵，抬起头神色慌乱的看着钱老爷子。
虽然钱老爷子一句话说得没头没尾的，可她就是懂了他话里的意思，顿时脸色大变，本就苍白的脸色更是血色尽无。
……
这边钱康很快接到了钱老爷子的电话，听完之后满脸愤慨。
从他的表情来看，林熙就能猜到肯定是抓到背后那个施咒的人了，她主动提出告辞。
第11章被下了咒
钱康回过神，又是感激又是敬佩。
content_en:
Chapter 11 Being cursed
But last night, they looked through all the videos at home, not just yesterday, but also the videos from the previous few days. They even invited experts in this field to investigate, but they found nothing unusual.
During this period, the nanny and the nanny are just like any other day. One is responsible for taking care of the child's food and daily life, and the other is responsible for playing with the child and providing enlightenment education.
It was around ten o'clock in the morning when Tongtong was lost. The nanny was making morning tea, and although the childcare teacher had slightly neglected her duty and went to the toilet, they couldn't let people hold on when they had three urgent needs.
Moreover, the child is usually very well-behaved and has never opened the door and sneaked out by himself. In addition, there are his favorite toys in the living room, so no one would have thought that he would get up and leave while playing.
No one told him to go out. Instead, it was as if he was attracted or guided by something and ran out.
As for the van waiting outside, it can also be explained that they have already done the work of checking the spot and have been squatting nearby. They only waited for Tongtong to come out and then acted quickly.
But for some reason, Qian Kang still felt that his family was definitely involved in this matter!
It's a pity that there is no evidence, and his intuition alone can't prove anything.
Qian Kang smiled bitterly, looking into Lin Xi's calm eyes and unconsciously spit out the troubles in his heart.
"Nothing has been found yet. All the evidence shows that the child ran out on his own, but..."
But what? Qian Kang didn't continue talking. After all, even the Qian family couldn't find any evidence about this matter. How could the little girl in front of him know about it.
Lin Xi looked at him and said quietly: "Your son has been cast a puppet curse."
Puppet curse? !
Qian Kang and his wife were stunned.
The two of them have always been in business, and businessmen inevitably believe in ghosts and gods. Their family and company spend a lot of money to find people who have specially studied Feng Shui. Therefore, the puppet technique mentioned by Lin Xi was unfamiliar to them at first, but after understanding the meaning of the word, they instantly became more serious.
"Ms. Lin, could you please take a moment to speak."
Thanks to the ancestors of the Qian family, Qian Kang has been among the group of people who have stood at the top of his peers since he was a child.
Standing high and seeing far, he will naturally see more of the world. He also firmly believes in one sentence, that is, there are people outside the world, and there is a sky outside the world. Some geniuses are never limited by age and gender.
Although the Lin Xi in front of him did not look like a heavenly master who understood the art of metaphysics, Qian Kang felt that this girl would be extraordinary in the future just because she could identify human traffickers on the train.
If what she said is true, maybe the mystery of her son's inexplicable escape can be solved!
It was not convenient for Lin Xi to take them to the Feng Shui shop, so he simply got into the car with Qian Kang and had a chat in the car.
She briefly explained the function of the puppet curse to Qian Kang and the others, and then said: "It is very simple to find the person who cast the spell. If the spell is broken, the person who cast the spell will suffer backlash. You can find someone to investigate who is doing something wrong in the family."
And the moment she just brushed away the Yin Qi from Tongtong, she also broke the little puppet curse.
When Qian Kang heard this, he immediately took out his mobile phone and called his father in Linshui, asking him to send a trustworthy person to Qian Kang's home to check the situation.
Qian Kang lives in the same villa area as his parents, and the two families are in the next building. After receiving a call from his son, Mr. Qian immediately took his confidants who had been with him for many years to Qian Kang's house next door to check on the situation.
As a result, as soon as he reached the door of Qian Kang's house, he saw the nanny opening the door and rushing out with a look of panic.
Seeing Mr. Qian, the nanny immediately cried for help: "Mr. Qian, Mr. Zhou was fine just now, but suddenly he vomited blood!"
Upon hearing this, Mr. Qian's eyes flashed, and he quickly walked in to check. Sure enough, he saw his grandson Tongtong's childcare teacher, Mr. Zhou, sitting on a stool, vomiting blood, and the clothes on his chest were wet with blood.
Thinking of my son just nowAs told to him on the phone, Mr. Qian's face was as dark as water. He looked at Teacher Zhou with a painful expression and sneered.
"Teacher Zhou, it must be you."
Teacher Zhou froze, raised his head and looked at Mr. Qian in panic.
Although Mr. Qian's words were confusing, she understood the meaning of his words, and her face suddenly changed, and her already pale face was completely drained of blood.
…
Qian Kang here quickly received a call from Mr. Qian, and his face was full of indignation after hearing it.
Judging from his expression, Lin Xi could guess that she must have caught the person behind the spell, so she took the initiative to say goodbye.
Chapter 11 Being cursed
Qian Kang came back to his senses, feeling both grateful and admired.
